description: Agent Education: submit a financial aid award letter with the disbursement record: the award letter with its institution, student, academic year, the day issued, currency, each award with its id, aid type (grant, scholarship, waiver, work study, subsidized loan, unsubsidized loan, parent loan, private loan or other), name, amount for the year and the amount stated for each term, and its stated total; and optionally the disbursement record with its student, currency and each disbursement with its id, the award it answers, its aid type, term, amount, the day disbursed and its status (disbursed, scheduled, cancelled or returned). The signed report gives the award letter with its total and the sum of its awards, the disbursement record with the lines counted, the disbursements recorded under another aid type and those answering no award, each award’s amount against what is disbursed for it, the terms disbursed above and below their stated amounts, the disbursements in a term their award does not list and the awards whose term amounts do not add up, and counts them, and names a divergent record: a disbursement recorded as another aid type, a disbursement for aid the letter does not state, more disbursed for an award than stated and more disbursed in a term than stated; then an award with no disbursement, a term disbursed below its stated amount, a disbursement in a term its award does not list, term amounts unlike the award, a total unlike the awards and a student named otherwise, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No disbursement record, a disbursement naming no award whose type fits none or several, or a disbursement with no term against an award that lists term amounts leaves the record unverified. Disbursed and scheduled lines count; cancelled and returned lines do not. Figures in different currencies are refused. This reads amounts, types and terms as stated: wever_invoice-payment-match matches one invoice to its payment, and wever_realty-closing-check reads a closing statement against the purchase agreement, while the aid check reads a student’s award letter against the disbursements made under it and decides no eligibility. Verdict edu_aid_divergent, edu_aid_partial, edu_aid_unverified or edu_aid_consistent. POST /api/edu-aid-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
